children: Australia’s ANZ–Indeed Job Ads rose 2.2% month -over-month in September 2026, slowing from a marginally revised 2.6% gain in the previous month despite marking the third straight month of expansion.
The continued increase suggested that labour demand remained resilient, although the slower pace pointed to some moderation in hiring momentum

title: Australia Job Ads Rise for 3rd Month
